_provenance.upstream_operation: sigGen (deterministic external/pure groups: context-length and message-length extremes)
_provenance.local_operation: deterministic SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKK_ML_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk) then C_SignInit(CKM_ML_DSA) with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context, C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file; same upstream file (and sha256) as mldsa_siggen_det_test.json
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Deterministic external/pure groups only, excluding tcIds already carried by mldsa_siggen_det_test.json. Per parameter set: the 0-byte-context case with the shortest message, the 255-byte-context (maximum) case with the shortest message, and the longest-message case of the remaining cases; ties by lowest tcId. No upstream deterministic case has a 1-byte context (the only 1-byte-context case in the file, hedged tgId 16 / tcId 239, uses SHA2-512/256, which has no PKCS#11 v3.2 mechanism), so the 1-byte and 256-byte context boundaries are product-authored probes, not NIST cases.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, message, context, signature (pk and deferred dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
